title: Credential Remediation Is Slow When You Don’t Know What Will Break
content_md: TL;DR More than 64% still valid after four years: GitGuardian’s State of Secrets Sprawl 2026 found that most valid secrets discovered in 2022 still worked in January 2026, because teams stall on what a revoke will break. exclude_reason: GitGuardian-sponsored secrets-remediation commentary; generic vendor guidance, not an incident.
